official_findings.finding: Premises-level data is UPRN based and derived from AddressBase Premium, filtered for postal addresses and demolished premises; current/future flags have documented lag and supplier-response gaps.

Recent contract changes may not be captured; deferred scope and current/future flags are not equivalent to current orderable service truth; BDUK and Ofcom premises bases/methods/reference dates differ.
Initial-scope contract progress is management information, not exact premise availability and not directly comparable to official statistics.
Small-user postcodes can contain many addresses, boundaries can straddle administrative areas, centroid assignment is not address-level proof, and postcodes can be recoded/re-used.

acceptance_principles: exact source epoch must be recorded
exact UPRN required for BDUK premise binding when used
postcode alone is insufficient parcel proof
source gaps and FALSE flags are not negative service proof
runtime Ofcom PASS remains mandatory before product migration
